result.summary: No clearly broken visual elements are apparent. The page is generally consistent and polished, with one minor carousel presentation issue.

issues.description: Items at the right edge of the horizontal category and restaurant carousels are abruptly clipped, including part of a category pill and the “Trattoria Picco…” card. Although this suggests horizontal scrolling, the cutoff looks slightly awkward.
issues.suggestion: Use consistent right-side padding and a deliberate partial-card preview, or add a subtle scroll affordance so the clipping clearly communicates horizontal scrolling.
